mapper.sql:
N.ID, N.CHILD_ID, N.AUTHOR, N.CONTENT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(N.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT,
COALESCE( (SELECT NULLIF(R.NICKNAME, '') FROM T_RELATIONSHIP R WHERE R.USER_ID = N.AUTHOR AND R.KINDERGARTEN_ID IN (SELECT CR.KINDERGARTEN_ID FROM T_RELATIONSHIP CR WHERE CR.USER_ID = N.CHILD_ID) LIMIT 1), (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = N.AUTHOR) ) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_PARENT_NOTE N WHERE N.CHILD_ID = #{childId} ORDER BY N.ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PARENT_NOTE(CHILD_ID, AUTHOR, CONTENT) VALUES (#{childId}, #{author}, #{content})
mapper.sql:
C.ID, C.NOTE_ID, C.AUTHOR, C.CONTENT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(C.CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT,
COALESCE( (SELECT NULLIF(R.NICKNAME, '') FROM T_RELATIONSHIP R WHERE R.USER_ID = C.AUTHOR AND R.KINDERGARTEN_ID IN (SELECT CR.KINDERGARTEN_ID FROM T_RELATIONSHIP CR JOIN T_PARENT_NOTE N ON N.CHILD_ID = CR.USER_ID WHERE N.ID = C.NOTE_ID) LIMIT 1), (SELECT U.NAME FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = C.AUTHOR) ) AUTHOR_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_PARENT_NOTE_COMMENT C WHERE C.NOTE_ID = #{noteId} ORDER BY C.ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_PARENT_NOTE_COMMENT(NOTE_ID, AUTHOR, CONTENT) VALUES (#{noteId}, #{author}, #{content})
